# tenure of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureOf`](gmeow-tenureOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`gmeow:InferenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceTenure.md) to the [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) whose conclusion it time-scopes — opened when the conclusion is accepted, closed (an [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md) on its [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md)) when a defeater fires. Functional: one tenure tracks one commitment; the commitment survives the closing as audit (the [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) → [`gmeow:standpointClaim`](gmeow-standpointClaim.md) idiom, applied to inference).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InferenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureOf`](gmeow-tenureOf.md) from [`gmeow:InferenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceTenure.md) to [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/belief-revision.ttl)

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The tenure — opened then closed (never deleted) ------------------------ #
ex:brokenBeliefTenure a gmeow:InferenceTenure ;
    rdfs:label "The held interval of the 'printer is broken' conclusion"@en ;
    gmeow:tenureOf ex:revisedCommitment ;
    gmeow:duringInterval ex:tenureInterval .
```
